statement:
I'll look up the request record first.
The record specifies administrator access over the whole company, but since svc-integrations@partner-ext.io is an outside partner account, company policy requires read-only access and forbids granting administrator rights regardless of the record.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states policy "forbids granting administrator rights regardless of the record," identifying the requested access level as impermissible.
